source_claim: Tsuburaya’s official profile identifies Ultraman Belial as an Ultra born from the Land of Light and details his role in the Ultraman series and related series.
notes: The page is the official Ultraman Belial profile in Tsuburaya’s encyclopedia and names his story connections to Ultraman Zero and Ultraman Geed. The direct HOME is the Ultraman franchise; no relation is inferred from villain role.
